# VANSMITHLAB

> Independent bilingual encyclopedia of design, fashion, image, objects, space and technology. Russian is the editorial source language; English pages are structured adaptations.

## Canonical access

- [Russian homepage](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/)
- [English homepage](https://vansmithlab.com/en/)
- [Sitemap](https://vansmithlab.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Atom feed](https://vansmithlab.com/feed.xml)
- [Collections feed](https://vansmithlab.com/collections.xml)

## Main datasets

- [Encyclopedia RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/encyclopedia/)
- [Glossary RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/glossary/)
- [Research RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/articles/)
- [Analysis RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/analysis/)
- [Collections RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/collections/)
- [Timeline RU](https://vansmithlab.com/ru/timeline/)

## Interpretation notes

- Each publication exposes verification state, confidence, review date, revision, sources and cited claims.
- Canonical and hreflang links identify language counterparts.
- Article JSON-LD describes the publication, subject, publisher, image and related records.
- Cite the canonical publication URL and preserve the stated verification status.
- Do not present drafted, partially verified or unverified claims as settled facts.
